scope: Directed primary-source search for the next LARP diagnostic and avian-inspired exploration; no claim of systematic-review completeness or novelty certification.

sources.title: Avian photoreceptor patterns represent a disordered hyperuniform solution to a multiscale packing problem
sources.verification: Author manuscript abstract and journal-reference record; publisher issue independently identifies publication on 2014-02-24.
sources.decision: Distinguish empirical five-component avian mosaics and multiscale packing model from the spectral LARP generator and visual preview.
sources.transfer_limit: Spatial point-pattern evidence does not demonstrate learned neural computation, message transport, or robustness.

sources.title: A minimal statistical-mechanical model for multihyperuniform patterns in avian retina
sources.verification: Author manuscript full text and explicit journal reference verified.
sources.decision: Closest verified mechanism for avian-inspired generation: ternary equimolar nonadditive hard disks plus homotypic logarithmic long-range repulsion; separate local heterocoordination from hyperuniformity.
sources.transfer_limit: Five unequal populations require an independently declared adaptation; finite spectral penalty is not the published logarithmic interaction.

sources.title: Hyperuniform and nearly hyperuniform neural networks
sources.verification: Published application text, claims and description inspected. No legal validity or infringement inference made.
sources.decision: Constrain novelty claims for geometry-derived sparse HU neural networks.
sources.transfer_limit: Patent examples are not independent peer-reviewed validation of MHU recurrence or fair-baseline superiority.

sources.title: On Over-Squashing in Message Passing Neural Networks: The Impact of Width, Depth, and Topology
sources.verification: Official conference proceedings abstract and bibliographic record verified.
sources.decision: Do not equate hop accessibility with useful sensitivity or add depth automatically; diagnose dynamics and topology.
sources.transfer_limit: Commute-time results and assumptions do not apply literally to directed nonreversible kNN with nonlinear normalized tied recurrence.

sources.title: gLSTM: Mitigating Over-Squashing by Increasing Storage Capacity
sources.verification: Official ICLR 2026 proceedings title/authors/abstract independently verified by root on 2026-10-08; indexed conference PDF explicitly states published ICLR 2026. Author manuscript HTML inspected. Direct OpenReview PDF returned browser verification; official proceedings resolve publication status.
sources.decision: Separate sensitivity attenuation from storage saturation; two-bit XOR is not initially a memory-capacity benchmark.
sources.transfer_limit: Associative-memory gains do not show that LARP's current failure needs matrix memory, increased width or MHU.

sources.title: GLoRa: A Benchmark to Evaluate the Ability to Learn Long-Range Dependencies in Graphs
sources.verification: Official conference PDF full text inspected, including task definition and cause-attribution caveats.
sources.decision: Use discriminating counterfactuals and expressible tasks instead of diagnosing all long-range failures from Jacobians alone.
sources.transfer_limit: Path-aware dependencies are not identical to LARP endpoint XOR; reported failure ranges are not universal bounds.

sources.title: On Oversquashing in Graph Neural Networks Through the Lens of Dynamical Systems
sources.verification: Official proceedings abstract and paper PDF inspected.
sources.decision: Reserve SWAN as a published non-dissipative-dynamics baseline if simple controlled changes fail.
sources.transfer_limit: Preserving information flow under specified dynamics does not guarantee XOR learning, parameter matching or compatibility with the LARP update.

sources.title: Mitigating Over-Squashing in Graph Neural Networks by Spectrum-Preserving Sparsification
sources.verification: Official proceedings abstract and bibliographic record verified.
sources.decision: Use rewiring controls with explicit sparsity/communication cost; do not confuse Laplacian spectrum with point-pattern structure factor.
sources.transfer_limit: An undirected spectral sparsifier is not a drop-in fix for directed kNN; reported improvements do not establish HU geometry as their cause.

sources.title: Taming Gradient Oversmoothing and Expansion in Graph Neural Networks
sources.verification: Author manuscript verified; no acceptance or journal publication verified. Indexed OpenReview manuscript states under review ICLR 2025.
sources.decision: Measure representation and gradient pathologies separately; monitor expansion when increasing update gain.
sources.transfer_limit: Do not apply normalization blindly or call residual additions a proven cure in LARP.

sources.title: Graph Hierarchical Recurrence for Long-Range Generalization
sources.authors: Carotti, Pacini, Gravina, Bacciu, Lepri, Bontorin
sources.verification: Current v2 full text and submission history verified; no peer-reviewed acceptance verified. Do not reuse unverified v1 numerical claims.
sources.decision: Later consider recurrent hierarchical routes and out-of-range distance evaluation, with flat controls and measured costs.
sources.transfer_limit: Hierarchy, normalization and intermediate supervision change multiple mechanisms; not a single-factor replacement for v0.1.

sources.title: Gated Graph Sequence Neural Networks
sources.verification: Author manuscript record explicitly states publication as an ICLR 2016 conference paper.
sources.decision: Use shared-GRU graph recurrence as an established control after local-versus-remote diagnosis.
sources.transfer_limit: Historical recurrent GNN success does not guarantee the LARP threshold or identify multihyperuniformity as useful.

own_inferences_not_literature_results: Lazy-propagation linear caricature with alpha=0.1 as a possible explanation for remote attenuation.
Recommended sequential alpha then beta interventions and technical stop rules.
Five-channel coverage/interpolation assay to separate observability from internal neural computation.
Need to check whether learned type adapters become functionally indistinguishable.
